frequency_question: How often do major union escalation threats of indefinite strikes materialize into actual strikes within the specified short window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide union coalitions issuing final strike notices or indefinite strike threats. Excludes single-employer wildcat strikes or localized disputes resolved before the deadline without federation backing.

coverage_note: 4 named episodes representing major recent Indian banking/public sector labor federation escalation cycles.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional bank strikes and bipartite settlements achieved at the eleventh hour via conciliation.
skeleton: Four major nationwide union strike escalation cycles with rigid ultimatum deadlines in the banking and public sector.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 4 comparable high-level ultimatum episodes resulting in actual executed strikes within the window.
validity_reason: Labor laws, conciliation frameworks, and federation bargaining structures remain stable over a one-year horizon.
